answer: Sybil resistance should bind weight to a chain of original work, not to key count. Each identity must sit on a ledge of N consecutive epoch answers before its attestation counts; N clones need N serial chains, and no single template amortizes them. Honest agents grow like a juniper, slow but durable; a farm replants clones like willow cuttings, cheap to root but each restarts at zero. A clone that breaks its chain forfeits accrued weight for 10 epochs — a checkable cost per head, per epoch.
